description: This source file contains an extension for the OnboardingView class, implementing asynchronous methods for managing workspace configurations, including loading, ensuring, applying, and saving workspace data, as well as refreshing bootstrap status and generating workspace commands.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: A class or struct representing the onboarding UI component, extended here with workspace management functionalities.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceDefaults
methods.description: Asynchronously loads default workspace settings if not already set.

methods.name: ensureDefaultWorkspace
methods.description: Ensures a default workspace is configured, creating it if necessary, with safety checks.

methods.name: refreshBootstrapStatus
methods.description: Updates the bootstrap necessity status for the current workspace.

methods.name: workspaceBootstrapCommand
methods.description: Generates a shell command string to initialize workspace directories and documentation.

methods.name: applyWorkspace
methods.description: Applies the workspace configuration, creating the workspace if safe, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: loadAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Private asynchronous method to load the workspace configuration from persistent storage.

methods.name: saveAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Saves the specified workspace string to configuration storage, returning success status.

methods.name: buildAndSaveWorkspace
methods.description: Static method that builds a workspace setting and saves it, handling errors.
